description: Pull specific fields out of one or more pages as JSON, shaped by a JSON schema or described in a prompt. Use it when you need values such as prices, names or dates rather than the whole page text.

preferStructure.description: Keep headings, lists and tables in the text handed to the model.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of what to pull.

schema.description: A JSON schema the result must conform to.

showConfidence.description: For each field, return a confidence score and the exact source passage the value was drawn from.

showSources.description: Return the list of URLs that were actually extracted.

name: extract
title: Extract
